ja: “褐色のサザンクロス隊”
高 機 動 型 ザ ク 地 上 用、 出 撃 ―
映画『機動戦士ガンダム ククルス・ドアンの島』より、“褐色のサザンクロス隊”隊長エグバ・アトラーが搭乗する
高機動型ザク 地上用がＨＧシリーズに登場。陸戦に特化した機体形状と武装類を新規造形で立体化。
特徴的な迷彩模様のカラーリングは成形色と水転写式デカールで再現。ジオン公国軍サザンクロス隊の部隊章やコーションマーク等を収録。
●　高機動型ザク 地上用の機体形状を新規造形を交え徹底再現！
外装の９割以上を新規造形。機体各所のディテールを精密に立体化。
頭部ブレードアンテナやシールドに加えホバー走行を可能にする腰部・脚部形状まで精密に再現。
●　膝部可動ギミック搭載
脚部関節には新規引き出しギミックを搭載。膝曲げ時の可動域が大幅に向上。
●　迷彩模様を成形色と水転写式デカールで再現
エグバ機の迷彩パターンを成形色と水転写式デカールで再現。塗装なしで印象的な迷彩模様を再現可能。
ジオン公国軍サザンクロス隊の部隊章やコーションマーク等を収録。
●　近接戦闘に特化した武装類を新規パーツで再現
G型・改良版ドラムマガジン式MS用マシンガン（銃剣付き）
着脱可能な銃剣付きの射撃武装を新規立体化。サブグリップは可動し様々なポージングに対応。
銃剣は腰部にマウント可能。
ヒート・剣
新規パーツを交え、白兵戦用の実体剣を再現。使用（発熱）時、収納時を差替え式で演出可能。
【使用時】イエローのエフェクトが付属。特徴的な基部の展開も差替え式で再現。
【収納時】ジョイントパーツを使用することでランドセルに収納できる。
●　アクションベース用ジョイントパーツやポージングの幅を広げる左平手パーツが付属。
付属武装：G型・改良版ドラムマガジン式 MS用マシンガン（銃剣付き） / ヒート・剣

en: “Brown Southern Cross Squad”
High mobility type Zaku ground use, sortie -
From the movie "Mobile Suit Gundam Cucurrus Doan's Island", Egba Atla, the leader of the "Brown Southern Cross", will be on board.
High mobility type Zaku ground version now available in the HG series. The aircraft shape and weapons specialized for land battles are three-dimensionalized with new modeling.
The characteristic camouflage pattern coloring is reproduced with molded colors and water transfer decals. Contains unit insignia and caution marks of the Zeon Principality Army Southern Cross Corps.
●High Mobility Type Zaku Thoroughly reproduces the ground aircraft shape with new modeling!
More than 90% of the exterior is new. Precisely three-dimensional details of various parts of the aircraft.
In addition to the blade antenna on the head and the seal, the shape of the waist and legs that enable hovering are precisely reproduced.
● Equipped with a movable knee gimmick
The leg joints are equipped with a new drawer gimmick. The range of motion when bending the knee is greatly improved.
● Reproduce the camouflage pattern with molded colors and water transfer decals
The camouflage pattern of the Egba machine is reproduced with molded colors and water transfer decals. Impressive camouflage patterns can be reproduced without painting.
Contains unit insignia and caution marks of the Zeon Principality Army Southern Cross Corps.
● Reproduce weapons specialized for close combat with new parts
G type/improved drum magazine type MS machine gun (with bayonet)
A new three-dimensional shooting weapon with a detachable bayonet. The sub-grip is movable and supports various poses.
The bayonet can be mounted on the waist.
heat sword
Reproduces a physical sword for hand-to-hand combat with new parts. Can be used interchangeably for when in use (generating heat) and when stored.
[When used] Comes with a yellow effect. The characteristic base development is also reproduced with interchangeable parts.
[When stored] Can be stored in a school bag by using joint parts.
● Comes with joint parts for action base and left palm part to expand the range of poses.
Attached weapons: G type improved drum magazine type MS machine gun (with bayonet) / heat sword
1/144 Scale Assembly plastic model
Target age: 8 years old and above
Product material: PS/PE
・No adhesive is used for assembly
